comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The bit that still surprises me: Kazakhstan has a long Caspian shoreline and is still formally landlocked, because the Caspian is an enclosed lake and the Volga-Don Canal is too small for ocean-going ships. And of the forty four landlocked countries on Earth, only two are doubly landlocked, ringed entirely by other landlocked states: Uzbekistan and Liechtenstein. Sources are in the description if you want to check the count. If you live somewhere inland, how far is the nearest port you actually use, and how many borders away is it?
